Which of the following is the most effective method for automatically generating stack traces on Unix systems when a SIGSEGV occurs?
A) Using gdb with core dumps
B) Implementing a custom SIGSEGV handler
C) Using valgrind for memory debugging
D) Setting up system-wide crash reporters

In Linux systems, gettimeofday() function:
A) Always provides microsecond resolution
B) Resolution depends on kernel compilation options
C) Provides nanosecond resolution by default
D) Resolution is hardware-dependent but consistent within the same system
